messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — elevated tool/function invocation rate in us-west-2. Worker queue growth and token latency spike. @sasha_oncall paged.

sasha_oncall: On it, joining bridge. grabbing logs + tracing.

sasha_oncall: quick tail: a burst of tool_call requests from a handful of tenants, biggest noisy one is acme-prod. many requests include structured output and nested tool calls.

jamal_sre: KV cache pressure + worker queue backlog confirmed. 95th latency 3x baseline. Error rate increasing on tool-exec path. Recommend soft mitigation: temporarily restrict tool calls for lower tiers and force text-only/disable structured output globally while we stabilize.

mina_prodops: +1 to soft restrictions. Proposed actions:
```
redwoodctl featureflag set runtime.allow_tool_calls false --scope=free-tier
redwoodctl config set api.enable_structured_output false --scope=global --ttl 30m
```
Also reduce per-tenant tool quota for noisy tenants (e.g., acme-prod) to limit blast radius.

sasha_oncall: applying feature flag now.

deploy-bot: Executing: redwoodctl featureflag set runtime.allow_tool_calls false --scope=free-tier
deploy-bot: Success — featureflag id=ff_3b9a; propagated to config service.

sasha_oncall: Setting structured output global flag.

deploy-bot: Executing: redwoodctl config set api.enable_structured_output false --scope=global --ttl 30m
deploy-bot: Success — config id=cfg_7a2f; cached configs will expire in 30m.

sasha_oncall: Also throttling acme-prod:
```
redwoodctl quota set acme-prod tool_calls_per_min 5
```
applied. monitoring the queue.

levi_runtime: Pushed gateway rule to force text-only fallback for /v1/chat and /v1/generate for affected racks. nginx policy snippet:
```
if ($http_x_allow_structured = "false") {
  proxy_set_header X-Response-Mode text-only;
}
```
This prevents streaming structured outputs for the next 30m.

elena_support: Notifying customers: drafting short status message for impacted tenants (free-tier + any tenant with quota reduced). Will tag enterprise contacts for acme-prod.

mina_prodops: On-call handoff plan: @jamal_sre you take the bridge in 20m. I'll prepare the incident summary and customer comms. If metrics don't improve within 15m, escalate to infra for capacity addition.

jamal_sre: Taking over in 20m. Initial read: tool_call rate down ~72%, queue latency trending down. Will watch for reconnect churn.

sasha_oncall: Leaving bridge to normal ops. If anything spikes again, ring infra and increase throttle granularity by tenant. :thumbsup:

elena_support: Status message posted to statuspage and customer mailing list. Ticket created: INC38012.

jamal_sre: Monitoring — worker queue length back to nominal, error rate dropping. Keep mitigation in place for 1 hour, then gradual rollbacks if stable.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated (soft restrictions applied). Monitoring window: 60m. Please update this thread if rolling back or reapplying.
